Type: acceptance gate
Work key: H06
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Service/operations lead
Scope: A packaged binary still needs protected startup, compatible schema and interpretable operational failures.

Work kind: acceptance-gate
Suggested delivery tranche: T5; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Validated configuration, protected origin, separate migration/runtime database roles and graceful restart work from the packaged distribution; invalid/recovery-closed/incompatible state cannot become ready.
2. A retained historical binary/catalog/blob corpus upgrades through the supported schema boundary without reinterpretation, export drift, revived authority or duplicate publication; interrupted/unsupported upgrades fail safely with a verified recovery route.
3. Health, metrics, bounded audit/operation diagnostics and tested local alert delivery expose dependency/capacity/integrity failures without secrets. Executed release-runner evidence identifies local versus hosted execution, and institutional alert acceptance remains O02.2.

Expected review receipt: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H06/receipt.json

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/institutional-readiness-backlog.json

Blocked by:
- O01: bd-01M4W40K19EDEPHZA7Y20F340Z
- O02.1: bd-01M4W5P86V3ZV697KZ1F85XFM4
- H06.1: bd-01M4X8MB2G63FDYPV1DPX759X1
- O02.5: bd-01M4W5P8S8QAHG81H5TXFMVJVQ
- H06.2: bd-01M4X8MB6FF93SWENVA4256H33

Review existing implementation receipts against this cross-cutting area. Do not duplicate or reparent their tasks. Close only with observed evidence; planning and previous unrelated tests are insufficient.

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H06: Review core: Safe operation and upgrades
